type Setting = { key: str, value: str }

-- Value given for name, the last one if repeated; None when absent.
lookup(keys: List[str], values: List[str], name: str) -> str? =
  pre keys.len() == values.len()
  ex lookup(["mode"], ["slow"], "mode") == "slow"
  var found: str? = None
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    if keys[i] == name
      found = values[i]
  found

-- Values of keys other than mode and level, in the order given.
extras(keys: List[str], values: List[str]) -> List[str] =
  pre keys.len() == values.len()
  ex extras(["mode", "x", "level", "y"], ["a", "b", "c", "d"]) == ["b", "d"]
  var out: List[str] = []
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    if keys[i] != "mode" and keys[i] != "level"
      out = out + [values[i].copy()]
  out

-- mode, level, then the other values; defaults fast and 3 when not given.
settings(keys: List[str], values: List[str]) -> List[str] =
  pre keys.len() == values.len()
  post out.len() >= 2
  ex settings(["level", "mode"], ["5", "dev"]) == ["dev", "5"]
  ex settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
  let mode = lookup(keys: keys, values: values, name: "mode") else "fast"
  let level = lookup(keys: keys, values: values, name: "level") else "3"
  var out: List[str] = [mode, level]
  for v in extras(keys: keys, values: values)
    out = out + [v.copy()]
  out
